description: Hands songs to the user to listen to: the finished song to enjoy (mode listen), examples to choose between (choose), or two versions to compare at the same playback position (ab). Where the chat app shows cards, a player plays them on the user's device with Moose Tracker's own engine, and its Download opens the song in the web app, which exports WAV or Ogg of any length on the user's computer; elsewhere the reply gives each song's share link. Use it when the song is ready for the user, not for checks, auditions or previews. Nothing is rendered in the cloud and it counts against no render quota. singalong (KUR-330) adds a bouncing-ball lyrics card for a sung song: a little moose hops syllable to syllable over the words while it plays, and Make video saves a WebM (VP9 + Opus) in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, light or dark, encoded on the user's device. The reply gives assetId: after the user makes the video, assets([assetId]) returns its download link (2 h) to attach in chat or email. Shown words: describe(topic="syntax", q="voice"). When you need the video file itself (to embed it, or to send it to someone), you must present it with mode:"review": the card shows the user the video to check, Accept sends you its download link (and assets([assetId]) returns it), Request changes sends you their notes to revise and present again. The MCP never sends anything: deliver it with your own messaging tools. Mode scan instead shows an upload button for a photo of sheet music (upload: the job id convert from photo gave), for chat apps that cannot pass an image to a tool. When it fits (a song with words, a teaching or classroom song, a party song, or a song made for someone: a birthday, a thank-you, get well, a greeting), you might offer a Singalong video, the words with a little moose hopping along, like a musical greeting card they can send. Offer it as an option; don't make one unasked. Schema 0479948e.

items.description: The songs, in the order to show them

label.description: What the user sees, e.g. "A: brighter mix"

mtl.description: Instead of ref: the song text

ref.description: The songId from the song reply (a share link or render asset id also works; a long link copied by hand can get damaged)

mode.description: listen: one finished song; choose: examples to pick from; ab: two versions; review: one sung song as a singalong video for the user to check (Accept gives you its link, Request changes their notes); scan: a photo upload button (no items). Default: listen for one item, ab for two, choose for more

aspect.description: 16:9 landscape (1280x720), 9:16 portrait for phones and stories (720x1280), 1:1 square (720x720)

format.description: webm (VP9 + Opus) is the default: leave it out. mp4 (H.264 + AAC) only when the user asks for an MP4. A device that can't make the one asked for makes the other

singalong.description: A sung song (a wave=voice lead with 'syl syllables): the card shows the words with a moose bouncing on each syllable, and its Make video saves a singalong video made on the user's device; the reply gives the assetId assets() fetches it with once the user has made it. listen mode, one item

upload.description: mode scan: the job id from convert from photo

name: present
title: Hand songs to the user
